desc: 圆领短袖撞色假两件配松紧腰吊裆七分裤，一套穿好男童夏日出行
leaf: 男童撞色假两件短袖T恤吊裆七分裤两件套
name: 男童假两件撞色吊裆裤两件套款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清是一整套而不是单件上衣，用干净挂拍抢点击并满足白底主图合规。
主图一秒法则：在首屏海报里用度假感色块把凉快好搭这个头号利益讲完，同时靠颈部以下裁切规避儿童面容。
shots.textZone: upper-left headline field above the shoulder line, one subline directly beneath it

shots.intent: 放大夏天童装最真实的两个麻烦：面料贴身闷汗、下装腰头勒，让家长在右屏看到这套的解法。
shots.textZone: one label line centered under each panel

shots.intent: 用织纹微距解释凉快不是口号：纱线圈粒与双层袖接界的真实质感，替家长回答闷不闷。
shots.textZone: lower-left single caption line above the hem edge

shots.intent: 机制解释：把前胸小图位、后背大图位、下摆双横带和加长内层袖这几个结构点用引线讲清，证明设计有依据。
shots.textZone: headline band across the top, two leader labels on each side of the garment

shots.intent: 让家长代入孩子出门状态：低机位仰角把吊裆落裆版型的垂坠与活动量讲清楚，儿童面容一律不入镜。
把版型松紧、厚薄、弹力、柔软、长度五档指数与基础信息结构化，消掉偏大偏小厚不厚的最后疑虑。
shots.textZone: right column holds the headline and the five index rows, upper-right block holds the basic info rows

shots.intent: 同一屏看全两个配色的正面与背面，选色选款一步到位，降低因看不清背面而退换的概率。
shots.textZone: one label slot above each column of the grid

shots.intent: 三处做工特写替家长回答磨不磨脖子勒不勒腰这类穿着体感问题。
shots.textZone: one label line centered under each of the three panels

shots.intent: 收掉风险：用车缝工序侧写与可替换资质位给出品质感，但不写任何编造的检测结论。
shots.textZone: upper-right headline with an accent underline, one short credential line beneath the accent underline

shots.intent: 详情页最后一步收口：整套挂拍加按钮把逛完的参数与细节转成下单动作。
shots.textZone: headline field above the set, rounded CTA button inside the solid block below the headline

style.backgroundSystem: seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF for the packshot, coastal panel #BEE4EE for the opening poster and the closing screen, mist panel #EEF2F3 for mechanism and spec infographics, cement-tone wall #C9CDD0 for worn street screens, porcelain panel #E9ECEE for construction close-ups; one flat accent block #1E9FC0 per screen, never a gradient and never a new hue
style.direction: cool coastal kids-apparel commerce, poster-grade flat color blocking with clean infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #16181A plus solid square index chips in #1E9FC0 for the parameter rows; no filled emblems, no seal realism, no certificate artwork
style.lightingSystem: daylight-cool 6000K key from the upper left, large softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every hem, raking side light only on texture screens, no harsh speculars and no warm cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool coastal children's apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF, cement-tone field #C9CDD0, one accent #1E9FC0 and label ink #16181A; daylight-cool 6000K lighting with an upper-left softbox key, bounce fill and true contact shadows under every hem; one modern geometric sans-serif plus one heavy poster grotesque used only on the two headline screens; background system of paper sweep #FFFFFF, coastal panel #BEE4EE, mist panel #EEF2F3 and cement-tone wall #C9CDD0 with one flat accent block per screen and never a gradient; surface system of matte paper #FFFFFF, oak ply board #DCC4A2, porcelain panel #E9ECEE and ribbed cement floor #B6BBBE; thin single-weight line icon style in #16181A with solid square index chips in #1E9FC0; the top and the bottom piece always read as one set at stable scale, every worn frame cropped from the neck down so no child face appears, and garment graphic zones described structurally and never redrawn; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hues
no mixed fonts and no handwritten, brush or retro lettering
no random backgrounds and no real seaside or stock scenery outside the two poster screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no child face, no teen or adult proportions and no invented body shape on the garments
no redrawn garment graphics and no duplicated print panels across screens
style.presentationRules: the short-sleeve top and the drop-crotch bottom always read as one set at the same scale across screens; every worn frame is cropped from the neck down or shot from behind so no child face ever appears; the front chest graphic zone, the rear graphic zone, the hem bands and the extended under-layer sleeve are named structurally and never redrawn; silhouettes fully visible on light screens, mid-shot crop allowed on mechanism and spec screens
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper sweep #FFFFFF, oak ply board #DCC4A2 for flat lays, porcelain panel #E9ECEE for construction close-ups, ribbed cement floor #B6BBBE for worn screens; garment surfaces stay flat, unwrinkled and free of lint
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label plus one heavy poster grotesque reserved for the two headline screens; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-48pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters
